speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis (likely secondary to acute sinusitis via hematogenous spread).

The absence of dysuria and suprapubic pain, combined with flank pain and fever following sinusitis, strongly suggests an upper urinary tract infection originating from a blood-borne source rather than ascending infection. I am waiting for your urinalysis and CBC results to confirm pyuria and bacteremia.
